column3: “a divine spirit” renders “the spirit of God (gods).”
“shall do homage” renders an uncertain verb, perhaps “shall kiss” or “shall be ordered.”
“Bow the knee!” renders “Abrek,” an Egyptian or uncertain word.
“Zaphenath-paneah” is an Egyptian name, and “On” is Heliopolis.
“all the storehouses” renders “all that was in them,” an elliptical phrase.
